🌟 tuios | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an advanced, efficient, and agent-aware terminal environment for developers, streamlining workflows and enhancing productivity through window management, session persistence, and inter-agent communication.
✨ Key Features: • Terminal multiplexer and window manager • Vim-like modal interface • Multiple terminal panes and workspaces • BSP tiling • Kitty graphics protocol support
📖 Summary: TUIOS is a Go-based terminal multiplexer and window manager that enhances productivity with a vim-like interface, BSP tiling, and advanced features for managing coding agents. It offers persistent sessions, cross-machine connectivity, and an inbox for agent communication, all within the terminal.
